scale_generation.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Edit the reference terrain texture into a NEW SCALE-CORRECT MATERIAL STUDY. Keep exactly its painting style, detail density per slab, muted cool grey palette, overall brightness, and uniform diffuse illumination. Change ONLY THE SPATIAL SCALE: show MUCH MORE ground so there are approximately NINE (9) full slab widths ACROSS the square, and approximately 9 to 11 staggered rows. This is about 80 to 100 SMALL irregular fitted flagstones across the whole image, NOT 9 large stones total. On the final 512x512 deliverable each individual stone must be roughly 50-70 pixels wide. At native 1254px output aim stone widths 125-160px. Do NOT retain the original large-slab layout. Zoom OUT roughly THREE TIMES relative to reference. Fill the entire image with small flagstones edge to edge; no frame, border, grid overlay or text. Keep organic irregular outlines and staggered joints, no perfectly regular square grid. Flat ground plane compatible with 3/4 top-down game camera; no horizon or vanishing point. Cool low-saturation neutral grey around mean sRGB (103,105,99); no warm brown cast. Equal ambient lighting everywhere, no directional illumination, specular highlights or cast shadows. Style invariant: Simplified hand-painted, quiet broad flat color blocks, very few soft brush marks, no cracks or moss. No character or objects. One opaque square texture only, not a contact sheet. Important final count check: a horizontal line through the center must cross 8 to 10 individual stones, not 3 or 4.
